name: Giulia Ferrante
headline: Product Designer | UX & Design Systems Specialist
summary: Product designer with 5 years of experience crafting user-centered digital products across fintech and e-commerce sectors. Skilled in translating user research into scalable design systems and intuitive interfaces. Passionate about collaborative, data-informed design processes that balance business goals with user needs.

responsibilities: Lead design system development and maintenance across web and mobile products
Conduct user research including interviews, surveys, and usability testing
Collaborate with product managers and engineers to define feature requirements
Create high-fidelity prototypes in Figma for stakeholder review
Mentor junior designers on design system best practices
Designed wireframes and interactive prototypes for e-commerce clients
Facilitated user testing sessions and synthesized findings into actionable insights
Contributed to establishing initial component library and style guide
Partnered with developers to ensure design implementation accuracy
Assisted senior designers with wireframing and visual design tasks
Supported user research efforts through note-taking and data organization
Created basic UI assets and icons for mobile applications
